run_Sam3VideoBase: run video object tracking inference using Sam3VideoBase with detector, tracker, and distributed GPU support
build_Sam3VideoBase_outputs: build output masks and scores for each tracked object from SAM3 video tracking propagation results
associate_Sam3VideoBase_det_trk: associate detector masks with existing track masks using IoU-based matching and threshold heuristics
update_Sam3VideoBase_masklet_confirmatio: update masklet confirmation status tracking which objects are confirmed or unconfirmed across frames
process_Sam3VideoBase_hotstart: process hotstart heuristics to remove unmatched or overlapping objects during the initial tracking period
